summary: The clipping-point construction and piecewise formula for the integrand are correct in all endpoint cases. The four kink-order regions exhaust the parameter space, and the three accepted predecessor facts apply exactly to the resulting endpoint and boundary cases, including the common boundary t=lambda. The final algebraic conversion from I+9J<0 to p<4/9 and from 5J+8R-3I>0 to the two strict conclusions is correct.
